description: Exploit, separating the two knobs that E053 confounded. On the E061 tip, keep the head output scale at 2x and halve the head-weight lr (in the SGD head group), changing nothing else. Under Agarwala et al., the effective head lr scales as lr·β², so the 2x scale also quadrupled the effective head step. Halving the lr tests whether part of E053's +0.44 pp came from temperature and part was a too-large head step. The lr is a per-group value in the schedule tensor, so recapture only if it is a graph constant. Run the official seeds plus dev seeds 3-12. Contingency: if dev falls by 0.15 pp or more, run 2x head lr next. If |Δ| < 0.1 pp, the head lr is not a live knob at this scale; close H1.10.2.
